name: Tesla
overview: The pioneer and market leader of electric vehicles in Australia, transforming the automotive landscape with the top-selling Model 3 and Model Y and an extensive nationwide Supercharger network.
australian_history: Tesla officially entered the Australian market in December 2014, delivering its first Model S sedans at a gala event in Sydney. Model X followed in 2016. However, the true Australian EV tipping point occurred in August 2019 with the launch of the Model 3. Built in Shanghai for the Australian market, the Model 3 delivered sharp pricing, class-leading range, and high-performance dual-motor capability. In June 2022, Tesla launched the Model Y SUV in Australia, which immediately surged to become Australia's best-selling electric vehicle and frequently ranked among the top three best-selling vehicles outright in national monthly sales charts. Tesla's proprietary Supercharger network spans coast to coast across Australia, from Cairns to Perth and across regional highways, driving mass-market EV adoption.

models_catalog.name: Model 3
models_catalog.overview: Australia's landmark electric sports sedan, progressing from original Standard Range Plus to the refined Highland update and 460hp Performance.

generations.summary: RWD (LFP battery), Long Range AWD (82kWh ternary NMC), and Performance (357kW, 0-100 in 3.3s, Track Mode).
Sleeker front/rear lighting, rear 8-inch screen, acoustic glass, ventilated seats, and 343kW Highland Performance.

models_catalog.name: Model Y
models_catalog.overview: Australia's top-selling electric SUV, offering expansive panoramic glass roof, cavernous cargo room, and class-leading energy efficiency.

generations.summary: Single-motor RWD (60kWh LFP, 455km WLTP), Long Range AWD (75kWh, 533km), and Performance AWD (357kW, 21-inch Uberturbines, 0-100 in 3.7s).

models_catalog.name: Model S
models_catalog.overview: Tesla's flagship sedan that introduced Australia to ludicrous electric acceleration and over-the-air software updates.

generations.summary: 60, 75D, 85, 90D, 100D, and P100D with Ludicrous Mode delivering 0-100 km/h in 2.6 seconds.
